acceptance_predicates.description: A reviewed local interpreter resolves inside the bounded sandbox without downloads or broad host mounts.
Missing, unsafe, or out-of-scope interpreter paths are rejected before spawn.
Focused runtime interpreter-resolution positive and hostile tests pass.

definition_of_done: Bind immutable spec and schema-v2 envelope.
Resolve only existing reviewed local interpreters within the sandbox scope.
Pass focused and applicable full tests.

inputs.description: Runtime sandbox launch specification and bounded path policy.
